ja: 百鬼夜行図（改変版：AI 生成の動画を重ねたもの）
en: Hyakki Yagyō-zu (Night Parade of One Hundred Demons), modified: with AI-generated video layers

ja: 【AI 生成のコンテンツを含む改変版です】東京大学総合図書館が所蔵する絵巻『百鬼夜行図』の画像に、絵の一部を AI で動かした 8 秒の動画 19 本を、切り出した元の場所に重ねたマニフェストです。動画の動き・音・細部は AI が作ったもので、原資料に描かれたものでも、学術的な復元でもありません。原資料の画像そのものには手を加えておらず、東京大学の IIIF Image API から読み込んでいます。原資料の姿を確かめるときや研究の典拠には、動画を隠すか、原資料のマニフェストをご覧ください。IIIF Cookbook のレシピ 0036（複数の画像からの合成）と同じ形で、追加の画像の代わりに動画（Video）を、#xywh で Canvas の一部に描いています。Canvas には duration を持たせていません。各動画の summary には、動画を作るときに使った動きの指示文が入っています。
en: [A modified version that contains AI-generated content] The handscroll Hyakki Yagyō-zu, held by The University of Tokyo General Library, with 19 eight-second AI-generated clips placed back on the regions of the picture they were made from. The motion, sound and details of the clips were made by AI: they are not in the original, and they are not a scholarly reconstruction. The image of the original itself is not altered; it is loaded from the IIIF Image API of The University of Tokyo. To see the original as it is, or to cite it in research, hide the clips or use the original manifest. The manifest has the shape of IIIF Cookbook recipe 0036 (Composition from Multiple Images): each added resource is a Video, painted on a region of the Canvas with #xywh. The Canvas has no duration. The summary of each clip is the motion prompt used to generate it.

Its gnarled hands grip the vessel tightly as it sways from side to side, occasionally stumbling before regaining its awkward rhythm and returning to its initial hunched posture. Gentle animation in the style of the original artwork.
